descriptionFull: The buff-bellied pipit ( Anthus rubescens ), or American pipit as it is known in North America, is a small songbird found on both sides of the northern Pacific. It was first described by Marmaduke Tunstall in his 1771 Ornithologia Britannica . It was formerly classified as a form of the water pipit.
